notes: The ref's package (insusty-prompt-coach/redaction, extension PR #132 and later) is installed from GitHub at the ref's commit into cache/module/<sha>/; the clone is only read.
Inference runs on onnxruntime-web WASM with default session options, like the extension.
OCR is not wired in Node: images and scanned pages are reported as the ref reports them with OCR off.
